content.text:
The robot found the red ball and stopped close to it, facing it. I then called rest, and it is now crouched with its motors off.

The ball was on the floor to the left of the starting direction, past a cardboard box. After the last turn it sat centered in the bottom camera, close to the feet. I didn't measure the exact distance. The last camera image after rest still shows the ball ahead.
